text:
maya: quick ping — PR #4282 splits the console metrics panel into per-route latency + error-rate widgets and adds a tiny trace hook to capture span.tags for rollout metrics. Can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4282

maya: diff is small: dashboard JSON + 2 lines in runtime to attach `rollout_id` to spans. snippet:
```js
// in tracing.ts
span.setTag('rollout_id', ctx.rolloutId)
```

raj: taking a look now, will try to review in the next hour. FYI CI is red on one flaky test: `tests/metrics_integration.test.ts::should_aggregate_errors` — might be unrelated but flagging. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Preview build passed — preview url: https://deploy-previews.redwood.dev/pr-4282

maya: thanks @raj — I pushed a fix for the flaky test in a follow-up commit (force-ignore one timing assertion). It shouldn't affect this PR's logic, only test stability.

sophia: skimming now. main question: are we gating the trace hook behind a feature flag? I don't want extra spans for customers on older plans. If not, can we add `if (ctx.metadata?.enable_rollout_tags)` around it? small change.

maya: good catch — I can gate it. updated branch with flag check and a tiny unit test. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/commit/abcd1234

alex: left one tiny comment on the dashboard JSON about panel titles. Also can we add a changelog entry under `console/metrics`? we should call out the per-route split for product.

raj: approved after one nit. :thumbsup: happy for maya to merge after changelog + sophia approval on the flag.

sophia: approved — flag looks good and default is off for Hosted tier. :shipit:

maya: thanks all. I'll add changelog and merge around 17:00 PT unless anyone objects. :calendar:

alex: no objections. go for it. :tada:
